## Reusable rules

1. **Encode duration units per wire field** Choose the duration encoding and numeric representation from that field’s wire contract. This patch documents integer milliseconds for some Foundry fields, but also uses seconds for hosted-agent timeouts and Java elapsed-time mappings; neither unit nor encoding is universal. *Scope:* Foundry duration fields and language-specific SDK projections; verify each field’s contract. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/common/servicepatterns.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/agents/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-java-azure-ai-agents/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/agents.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/protocol.tsp

2. **Keep SDK mappings compatible with discriminators** The Java customization records that replacing a discriminated subtype with an external alternate type can remove information the emitter needs. It instead scopes redundant leaf properties out of Java while preserving the inherited discriminator. Treat these as emitter- and hierarchy-specific remedies, not blanket mapping rules. *Scope:* SDK customizations for discriminated TypeSpec models, especially Java alternate types and generated leaf properties. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-java-azure-ai-agents/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-java-azure-ai-agents/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-csharp-azure-ai-projects-agents/client.tsp

3. **Model arbitrary JSON as arbitrary JSON** The patch notes that an empty model generates Java serialization that silently discards a schema payload, and maps that field to unknown instead. Use a JSON-capable representation when the contract allows arbitrary structure; do not infer this from a field name alone. *Scope:* Fields whose wire contract accepts arbitrary JSON, including SDK projections of schema values. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-java-azure-ai-agents/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-csharp-azure-ai-extensions-openai/client.tsp

4. **Specify omission, null, and defaults independently** The declarations distinguish omitted values with server defaults, explicit nulls that clear or disable values, and omitted updates that leave state unchanged. Preserve those distinctions only where the service contract establishes them; this PR’s defaults are field-specific, not a general convention. *Scope:* Foundry request and response models, especially create/update fields and nullable settings. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/agent-insights/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/agent-insights/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/routines/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/tools/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/agents.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/776250727ee87574d307a7fbe8cb4a7d6ea987d2/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/routes.tsp
